Packet `test-design` is complete.

- Regression seams: phase aggregates, fixture validation/metric policy, numeric missing-usage reporting, and legacy control-oracle normalization.
- Assertions reside in `tools/tests/**`; no production or operational-evidence files were changed in this run.
- Pre-remediation handoff records eight deterministic RED failures; the subsequent context-relevance policy regression is also covered.
- Current candidate validation passed:
  - `node tools/tests/context-envelope-efficiency-probe.mjs`
  - Node syntax checks
  - `git diff --check`
- `tools/tests/**` is clean.

Packet `review-remediation` completed at candidate `e8d7caf`.

Changed areas:

- Phase token aggregation now uses all-or-unavailable semantics.
- Evaluation fixtures require `sourceEnvelopes` arrays.
- `missingUsage` is rendered numerically.
- Control-oracle input normalization supports legacy `contextTokens`.
- `contextRelevance` obeys explicit unavailable policy while remaining observable without suppression.
- Review-delivery regeneration includes `state.json` and `telemetry.jsonl`.
- Stale `f8a7744` evidence is explicitly invalidated.
- `check:docs` now has an executable npm contract.

Observed checks:

- `npm run test:harness` — pass, 117/117.
- `node tools/tests/context-envelope-efficiency-probe.mjs` — pass.
- `openspec validate bound-guarded-worker-context-envelope --strict` — pass.
- `git diff --check` — pass.

Unresolved delivery work:

- Durable validation/TDD evidence still needs root-orchestrator rebinding from `47d711a` to current candidate `e8d7caf`.
- Root-owned generated orchestration briefs still need formatting before `npm run check:docs` can be reported as passing.
- No PR merge was performed.
